name: Prism Ritual
summary:
AMPLIFY YOUR MUSIC EXPERIENCE

Your favorite track. A live concert video. A space filled with music. Prism Ritual turns listening into movement, and movement into visible expression. Make the space your own.

FIND YOUR RHYTHM
Drum with your fists to begin. Rainbow images emerge from your surroundings, and your voice and nearby sounds bring them closer. There is no fixed choreography and no perfect beat to chase. Move when the music moves you.

TO YOU, IT LOOKS LIKE MAGIC. TO OTHERS, IT LOOKS LIKE DANCE.
Poi
